newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Siltek up as market cheers yr results.
newsitem.headline: Siltek up as market cheers yr results.

text.p: Shares in South African electronics to information technology firm Siltek Ltd rose on Tuesday after the firm raised headline earnings for the year ended June 30, dealers said.
Siltek announced results on Monday showing headline earnings per share up to 202.53 cents from 173.96 cents previously.
By about 0820 GMT Siltek was up 100 cents at 24.00 rand with volumes traded on the stock at over 6.3 million rand.
The share was among the value leaders on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE).

Dealers said that despite a slide in Siltek's attributable earnings to 197.67 cents from 412.31 cents per share, the market perceieved increased future earnings growth due the firm's ability to effect stringent cost control measures.
"I think they are up on the results. Their results were slightly better and I think within the market's expectations," one dealer at the JSE said.
"They also had good cost control which the market expects to continue," the dealer added.
Siltek added that it planned to invest in high-growth opportunities in selected areas of the information technology industry in the current year.
